content.short: A comprehensive DeFi super app on Aptos unifying lending, borrowing, swapping, and margin trading in a single interface.
content.description: Aries Markets is a comprehensive "DeFi Super App" on Aptos that unifies lending, borrowing, swapping, and margin trading into a single interface. It features a Unified Margin Account that consolidates all DeFi activities, allowing for seamless cross-collateralization across assets. This architecture provides users with maximum capital efficiency and a streamlined experience. The platform includes an on-chain order book for high-speed margin trading and an Efficiency Mode that optimizes borrowing power. By leveraging Aptos' high throughput, Aries Markets delivers lightning-fast execution and a professional-grade DeFi suite.
